run.status_reason: Market prices and FX are as of 2026-08-14, while the latest complete capital-structure snapshot is 2026-03-31. Operating scenarios still depend on one broker model and internal estimates.

hkd_cny.basis: CFETS/PBOC central parity, not an intraday executable FX quote

shares.treatment: Treasury shares are excluded from market equity and the per-share denominator.

capital_structure.bridge_policy: Base EV bridge adds interest-bearing debt and minority interest, then subtracts monetary funds. Financial and equity investments are not deducted until operating versus non-operating treatment is proven; lease liabilities are already included in interest-bearing debt.

wacc.equity_risk_premium_source: Damodaran China total equity risk premium, accessed 2026-08-15
wacc.beta_method: 5-year weekly adjusted-price beta: 601869.SS versus CSI 300; low correlation makes this a sensitivity input rather than a settled issuer beta
wacc.pre_tax_cost_of_debt_method: 2026Q1 interest expense annualized divided by approximate average interest-bearing debt

timing.treatment: Only the estimated remaining share of 2026 FCFF is included; 2027-2032 are full years. This is an approximation because no 2026H1 actual cash-flow statement was available at the run cutoff.

bear.label: Supply expands quickly
bear.provenance: Jefferies 2026-07-22 forecast for revenue, EBIT, D&A, capex and working-capital cash effect; terminal FCFF is normalized internally instead of using the report's 2032 working-capital release.

base.label: Intermediate normalization
base.provenance: Internal research estimate dated 2026-08-15. It retains the broker's 2026 starting point, assumes a slower price/margin fade, and does not claim direct company guidance.

bull.label: Effective supply remains constrained
bull.provenance: Internal research estimate dated 2026-08-15. It assumes stronger specialty-fiber and optical-interconnect contribution and a longer high-margin period; these operating drivers are not yet directly evidenced.

reverse_dcf.interpretation: Mechanical diagnostic: 2026-2027 FCFF is fixed to the bear case, then 2028-2032 revenue is held flat and a steady EBIT margin is solved. It is not a forecast or target price.

sources.name: YOFC 2026Q1 report
sources.use: cash, debt components, minority interest, Q1 tax and interest expense

sources.use: debt rate ranges and 2025 reference data
